## What's Changed
- New "PSVR/TOBII" NEXT model for PSVR 2 users and those with tobii based hmds. This is alpha as there is limited data but it should work for those who have contributed!
- Reworked data collection flow so uploads happen in app and encrypted.
 This will help me iterate faster and makes submission easier.
- Reworked VR overlay to fix issues
- Fixed overlay on linux
- NEXT ETVR model update, stereo and mono models in one omnimodel and stereo gets improvements to help when one camera lags or drops frames the output should still stay cohesive and lowest latency possible
- NEXT should have improved axis handling on rotated cameras (but this likely is not fully fixed, but i am working on it!)
- NEXT should be even more resilient to hmd shifts over time
- Data collection gives more accurate data to help tune models
- NEXT Smart calibration should give better results
- Various bug fixes
- Bug report from inside the app to help speed up fixing of issues and inform me of bugs! Please report *anything* that feels like a bug, hard to understand, confusing, broken, weird looking, etc so I can iterate and improve them. thank you!
* Pro gui retheme by @prohurtz in https://github.com/EyeTrackVR/EyeTrackVR/pull/154


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/EyeTrackVR/EyeTrackVR/compare/EyeTrackApp-0.2.5.6...EyeTrackApp-0.3.0-BETA-10

summary:
## 🌟 Summary
**Ultralytics 8.4.189 improves deployment reliability and inference robustness**, with key fixes for Sony IMX500 and Hailo exports, clearer dataset errors, and safer handling of model outputs. No model architecture changes were introduced.

## 📊 Key Changes
- **More reliable IMX500 exports:** Updated converter requirements and aligned dependency versions. IMX500 export is now explicitly supported on Linux with Python 3.10–3.12.
- **Fixed Hailo segmentation exports:** The segmentation prototype output node is now detected from the exported model, helping accommodate different model activations.
- **Clearer dataset failures:** Unreadable datasets are less likely to be reported misleadingly as datasets with no labels.
- **Broader export compatibility:** Replaced several `einsum` operations with equivalent matrix multiplications, enabling affected YOLOE and YOLO-World models to export to ONNX at lower opsets.
- **More robust predictions and results:** Classification probabilities are preserved between inference calls; grayscale images and results without boxes are handled more safely.
- **Safer TensorFlow exports:** Existing ONNX Runtime variants, including Windows ML and Vitis AI builds, are recognized to avoid unnecessary runtime replacement.
- **Updated mobile guidance and benchmarks:** LiteRT, QNN, and Core ML performance tables were refreshed, and Platform documentation now explains how to open compatible exports in the Ultralytics YOLO app.

## 🎯 Purpose & Impact
- **Fewer deployment and setup failures:** The IMX500 dependency and Python-version updates address real export and inference issues; Hailo and ONNX fixes broaden export compatibility.
- **More dependable inference:** Saved classification results no longer change when a backend reuses its output buffer, and image/result utilities better handle uncommon inputs.
- **Easier troubleshooting:** Dataset errors are less confusing, helping users identify the underlying issue sooner.
- **Better mobile deployment guidance:** Updated device measurements and app instructions make it easier to evaluate and try exported models on phones.

## What's Changed
* Document opening Platform exports in the Ultralytics YOLO app by @glenn-jocher in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26875
* Refresh mobile benchmark tables with Ultralytics 8.4.188 assets by @glenn-jocher in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26874
* Fix IndexError on 2D grayscale NumPy images in Annotator and save_one_box by @Rahulbiradar9 in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26878
* Fix YOLOE and YOLO-World low-opset ONNX exports at source by @Y-T-G in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26881
* Fix classification dataset URL scheme handling by @Vaishnavi220506 in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26879
* Document momentum behaviour under optimizer=auto by @mh-masum6875 in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26877
* Fix TF-family export clobbering onnxruntime-windowsml installs by @cainiao33 in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26870
* Fix Results.save_crop and verbose when boxes are missing by @wizzseen in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26868
* Preserve classification probabilities across inference calls by @aswanth-07 in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26860
* `ultralytics 8.4.189` Fix IMX requirements, Hailo seg end nodes and unreadable-dataset errors by @glenn-jocher in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26883

## New Contributors
* @mh-masum6875 made their first contribution in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26877

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/compare/v8.4.188...v8.4.189
